run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:37:33Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is backed by frontend's own error spans, which start in the bucket ending 01:37:00 and are confined to the ad call path: at 01:37:33 frontend had 34.74 error spans on each of GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, plus 9.47 tcp.connect errors, while its CartService and CheckoutService client calls recorded zero errors. That path's dependency, the otel-demo ad workload, is down: its only pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) is Running but Ready=False since 01:39:50, restartCount 4, current and previous container state terminated OOMKilled exit 137 against a 450Mi memory limit; the ad Deployment shows unavailableReplicas 1 with Available=False since 01:39:50, the ad Endpoints object holds only a notReadyAddresses entry and no ready address, and ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server-span rate fell from about 149 per 2 minutes at 01:36:00 to 0 from 01:39:00 onward. Cluster events tie this to a repeating injected fault: Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned memory-stress StressChaos experiments roughly every 60 seconds from 01:35:38, each reporting 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad', followed by the kubelet's first BackOff event on that container at 01:36:47 and repeated OOMKills. The observed chain is memory stress on the ad container, causing OOMKilled restarts and NotReady, leaving the ad Service without a ready endpoint, so frontend's GetAds calls fail and its GET /api/data and GET spans error, producing the RequestErrorRate warning for frontend. Unresolved items are recorded as gaps, including the unreadable Chaos Mesh custom resources and the limited Jaeger/Prometheus coverage of the window.

claims.text: At 01:37:33, over the preceding 10 minutes, service frontend showed 34.74 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on each of GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, and 9.47 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on tcp.connect, while grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and POST /api/checkout recorded 0 error spans.

Frontend's error-span rate was 0 in every 5-minute increase point from 01:15:00 through 01:35:00, then rose to 222.22 (bucket ending 01:40:00) and 335.56 (bucket ending 01:45:00); a finer 2-minute view shows the first non-zero value (188) at 01:37:00 and continued errors through the last sample at 01:47:00.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in namespace otel-demo (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, container 'ad', memory limit 450Mi, memory request 225Mi) is not ready: Ready=False and ContainersReady=False since 2026-11-18T01:39:50Z with reason ContainersNotReady, restartCount 4, container not started, current state terminated reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-18T01:39:49Z and lastState terminated reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-18T01:38:47Z.

Deployment ad in otel-demo has spec.replicas 1 with readyReplicas null, availableReplicas null, unavailableReplicas 1 and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 01:39:50, while Deployment frontend has 1 replica with readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1.

The Endpoints object named ad in otel-demo contains only a notReadyAddresses entry (pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5, IP 100.96.2.230) for port tcp-service/8080 and no ready addresses, whereas the other otel-demo Service endpoints each list ready addresses for their pods; the ad Service selects pods with label opentelemetry.io/name=ad and exposes port 8080.

Service ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server-span rate collapsed from 169.3 per 2 minutes at 01:32:00 and 149.3 at 01:36:00 to 97.3 at 01:37:00 and 24 at 01:38:00, then was 0 at every point from 01:39:00 through the last sample at 01:47:00.

Chaos Mesh events in namespace chaos-mesh show Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress creating StressChaos objects starting 01:35:38 (otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq, then -7n9mk, -8b272, -sh425, -w8tqb, -w4ct8, -w98sl, -9ncrx); each records 'Experiment has started' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' as memory-stress experiments of about 55 seconds, re-spawned roughly every 60 seconds, and the final spawn attempts were refused with 'Forbid spawning new job because: ... is still running'.

Kubelet events on pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 show 'Started container ad' with count 6 (firstTimestamp 00:59:12Z, lastTimestamp 01:41:18Z) and a BackOff event 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' with count 23, firstTimestamp 01:36:47Z and lastTimestamp 01:44:26Z.

In the otel-demo pod table read at about 01:55Z every other pod (21 pods returned) is Running with restart count 0 and ready true, including the pods of cart, checkout, currency, email, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation and shipping; only ad-554b849958-l9ft5 shows ready=false with last termination OOMKilled exit 137.

The recurring memory-stress chaos applied to container ad of pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 pushed its memory past the 450Mi limit, producing the OOMKilled exit 137 restarts and a not-ready pod; with the ad Service having no ready endpoint, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls failed (visible as frontend tcp.connect error spans) and its GET /api/data and GET spans errored, which is what the RequestErrorRate warning for service frontend measures.

An intrinsic ad memory leak building up since pod start (00:59:09Z) is not supported as the trigger: ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds rate held at roughly 150 spans per 2 minutes until 01:36:00, the first BackOff event on the container is at 01:36:47Z (69s after the first stress experiment was applied at 01:35:38Z), and no BackOff event is recorded before that.

Node-wide memory exhaustion on the node hosting the ad pod is not supported: the ad pod runs on node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, and every other otel-demo pod in the pod listing, including those on the same node such as cart, currency, frontend, frontend-proxy, kafka, payment and postgresql, is Running, ready and has 0 restarts.

Frontend itself was not degraded outside the ad call path: Deployment frontend reports 1 ready and 1 available replica, its pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running and ready with 0 restarts, and all of its non-ad client operations (CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, RecommendationService/ListRecommendations) recorded 0 error spans in the 10 minutes to 01:37:33.

The ad process itself did not report application-level gRPC errors before it stopped serving: in the 10 minutes to 01:37:33 its oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans were STATUS_CODE_UNSET (461.05) with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for that operation, so the frontend-side GetAds failures are consistent with reaching a service that has no ready endpoint rather than with ad returning an error code.

Confirm ownership of the Chaos Mesh object and, if the memory-stress experiment on otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad is not intended, suspend or delete Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh (or pause its spawning of StressChaos jobs) to stop the recurring OOMKills of the ad container; this is advisory and was not executed.

Because the ad container is OOMKilled at its 450Mi memory limit under the injected memory stress, review the ad Deployment memory limit and request (450Mi/225Mi) together with the stressor size, and after the chaos is removed verify recovery by checking pod readiness, the ad Endpoints ready addresses and frontend GetAds error spans.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh custom resources could not be read with the available Kubernetes kinds (Schedule and StressChaos were not returned), so the stressor parameters (workers, memory size), the Schedule's spec and its creation/change time are unknown; the change_history integration is not available, so when and by whom Schedule chaos-mesh/otel-demo-ad-memory-stress was created cannot be verified.

Queries matching {__name__=~"kube_.*"}, kube_pod_container_info, kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no data, so kube-state-metrics time series for restart counts and readiness are unavailable and the pod/DaemonSet state evidence is a single point-in-time read at about 01:55Z, not a history across the incident.
Prometheus rules queries for RequestErrorRate and for all alert type rules returned no data, so the alert's exact expression and threshold are unverified.

Jaeger traces for service frontend returned no data in the filtered 01:22-01:45 and 01:30-01:45 searches; the unfiltered frontend trace sample covered only 01:27:45-01:27:49 (HTTP 200 responses), so there is no trace-level or error-detail view of the failing GetAds/GET requests after the 01:35-01:37 onset, and that sampled view does not describe requests outside that minute.

Prometheus samples of traces_span_metrics_calls_total end at 01:47:00, so frontend error rate and ad span activity between 01:47:00 and 01:54:53 are unknown; the ad pod was still not ready and restarting when the cluster was read.

Frontend pod logs in the 01:20-01:45 window returned no data (0 lines read), so frontend's own application log error text is unavailable and frontend health was judged from its spans, deployment status and pod status only.

The previous instance of the ad container had no retrievable logs, and the current instance's logs were read only through 01:35:38, so the ad container's own log lines at the moment of the OOMKills are unknown.
A trace search by tag error=true for frontend in 01:22-01:40 returned no data, so error-tagged trace detail for the alerting period is missing.
next_steps: Ask the cluster and chaos owners whether Schedule chaos-mesh/otel-demo-ad-memory-stress is an intentional experiment, and obtain its spec (target selector, stressor memory size, duration, scheduler).
Compare the ad Deployment's 450Mi memory limit with the ad service's real working set and decide whether to raise the limit or stop the memory stressor.

After any chaos change, re-check ad pod readiness, ad Service endpoints ready addresses, ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate and frontend error spans on GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds.
Load the RequestErrorRate alerting rule in Prometheus to confirm the exact error-rate expression and threshold used for service frontend.
